summary: This is an additive, low-blast-radius change that builds a one-way sync (MASTER_INDEX.yaml registries: -> knowledge_engine rows) plus a real fix for a previously-silent Supabase credential-degrade path; all four changed Python files compile cleanly, all four changed/added YAML files parse, subprocess calls use list-form args (no shell injection risk), SQL writes are parameterized, and the new knowledge_engine write path correctly reuses the existing AFTER UPDATE FTS5 trigger so the search index cannot desync. The task-gateway.py wiring (MASTER_INDEX_REGISTRIES_SYNC pointing at {AI_OS}/scripts/sync_master_index_registries.py while the new script is committed at ai-os-scripts/sync_master_index_registries.py) initially looked like a broken path, but line 366 of task-gateway.py documents an established repo-root-to-live-deployment convention (ai-os-scripts/ mirrors live ai-os/scripts/) already used by many other scripts in this repo, so it is consistent rather than a bug. No changes touch .github/workflows/**, migrations, schema files, auth/permission/payment/billing/rls paths, or .env files, and the diff is net-additive (no heavy deletions), so tier1 classification is correct.
